quests.title: Toward Red-Hot Adventure!

dialogue.t: Ad astra abyssosque! Welcome to the Adventurers' Guild, and to Natlan.
Please wait a moment. Once you've registered, you'll be able to accept commissions here.
Natlan is a land full of challenge and opportunity, filled with powerful foes and unexplored ruins.
Be bold and confident, and you'll be able to seize these opportunities and accomplish great things.
Ad astra abyssosque, Adventurer! Forge onward, to reach the stars and conquer the abyss!

quests.description: You meet Katheryne once again in Natlan…
